column1: # Form words: a word anywhere in the item moves it from one aisle to another, whatever the head word is
# ("chiles en lata" → abarrotes, "verduras congeladas" → congelados). Human file, drafted by Claude (AI) on 2026-10-22,
# awaiting owner review. "from" is an aisle id or "*" (any aisle). The matcher (src/model/aisles.js) drops filler words
# ("en", "de") and stems singular and plural alike, so "en lata" is the word "lata" and "congelados" is "congelado";
# masculine and feminine stem differently, so both are listed where both occur. The first form word in the item whose
# rule fits the item's aisle applies.

column4: frozen anything is in the freezer: "camarón congelado", "pollo congelado", "brócoli congelado"
feminine of the above: "verduras congeladas", "pizza congelada"
canned vegetables: "chiles en lata", "elote en lata", "champiñones en lata"
canned fish and meat: "pescado en lata"
fruit in syrup: "duraznos en almíbar", "piña en almíbar" (QQP)
powdered: "ajo en polvo", "chile en polvo" (ENIGH 011793); milk and detergent are not moved
ground spices: "chile molido", "ajo molido"; "carne molida" is meat, not fru, and stays
dried chiles and mushrooms: "chiles secos", "hongos secos" (QQP Chile Seco, Legumbres Secas)
